standard.summary: 推荐第一步尝试。交换 U-Net output blocks
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Recommended as the first thing to try. Swaps the U-Net output blocks
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 推荐第一步尝试。交换 U-Net output blocks，通常速度影响最小；如果本来能跑，就不建议开

advanced_en.principle: Recommended to try first. Swaps U-Net output blocks — usually the least speed impact; if training already fits, don't enable it.
